narrative: The tech landscape is rapidly evolving with significant advancements in AI, notably with agentic AI making strides in enterprise and consumer applications. Autonomous systems, from robotaxis to space exploration, continue to push boundaries, while core digital infrastructure is seeing key developments in security and cloud services. Developers are also seeing new tools and challenges, such as faster AST parsing and changes in browser extension policies.

highlights.title: Self-driving tech supplier Mobileye wants to be part of the robotaxi revolution — again
highlights.whyItMatters: Mobileye is re-entering the robotaxi market, signaling renewed investment and competition in autonomous driving technology.

highlights.title: Apple 2027 rumors: AirPods with cameras for AI and the second folding iPhone
highlights.whyItMatters: This indicates Apple's strategic focus on integrating advanced AI capabilities into future consumer devices and exploring new form factors like foldable phones.

highlights.title: NASA’s Quantum Lab Aboard Space Station Gets Chilly Upgrade
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's Cold Atom Lab upgrade on the ISS advances quantum technology and fundamental physics research in microgravity.

highlights.title: HPE AI Factory With NVIDIA Expands for the Era of Agents
highlights.whyItMatters: NVIDIA and HPE are collaborating to scale AI factory infrastructure, focusing on agentic AI deployments for enterprises.

highlights.title: Making ast.walk 220x Faster
highlights.whyItMatters: Improvements in AST traversal performance can significantly impact developer tools and code analysis, leading to faster development cycles.

highlights.title: SpaceX passes Amazon as valuation balloons to $2.7T
highlights.whyItMatters: SpaceX's surging valuation highlights the increasing investor confidence and rapid growth in the private space sector and its AI potential.

highlights.title: Google Chrome update will close the door on ad blockers
highlights.whyItMatters: This change in Chrome's extension policy will significantly impact ad-blocking technologies and the broader web browsing experience.

highlights.title: Cloudflare DMARC Management is now generally available
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's new DMARC management offering enhances email security for businesses by providing unified visibility and enforcement.
